data.name: Riya
data.gender_notes: Riya is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Often derived from the Sanskrit rī, 'to sing' or 'to flow'; the 'ray of light' sense is a modern gloss. Its root is Sanskrit ri (री). A modern popular Indian given name. Riya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Singer; (also) a ray of light”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Riya expresses “Singer; (also) a ray of light”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Often derived from the Sanskrit rī, 'to sing' or 'to flow'; the 'ray of light' sense is a modern gloss.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riya total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
